CHASE.description: When the next card played this turn is a Strike, apply the corresponding effect
CHASE.title: Chase
CHARGES.description: Can only be played when Charge progress is full. Playing it consumes the charge. Each card you play adds 2 Charge progress. When the maximum is reached, it is immediately returned to your hand. At the start of combat, if Charge progress is not full, it is consumed directly.
CHARGES.title: Charge
NIGHTSPOWER.description: There are 8 types: Beast's Hunt, Endless Appetite, Gathering of Wisdom, Fused Life, Demon's Wings, Blessing of the Radiant Knight, Chilly Mirage, and Grudge of the Discarded
NIGHTSPOWER.title: Night Lord's Power
MAGICBUFF.description: Enchantments cannot coexist. Applying a new Enchantment removes the existing one
MAGICBUFF.title: Enchantment
TUCI.description: If the target's intent is to attack, damage dealt is increased by 50%
TUCI.title: Thrust Counter
COUNTS.description: When you have at least 3 Madness cards in hand, lose 2 Energy and take 10 damage
COUNTS.title: Madness Accumulation
